source_review: Read existing claims audits first, then verified relevant issuer filing facts through current web search and official annual/IRS pages. Issuer HTML open timed out; primary-source indexed text and existing full downloaded filing text used together.

items.locator: Balance sheet; Notes 8/9/14; deferred compensation balance; pension from annual Note18
items.model: Adds 8.798 + .478 and deducts 3.1 + .459 pension + .215 + 1 = 4.502B. Existing net_other_assets_B is exact. Pension uses stale but explicitly identified annual figure.
items.decision: No new asset. Do not restore the previously deducted 1.215B claims.

items.model: Altera included in 8.798B equity investments. Mobileye/IMS inside consolidated operations; economic NCI reserve deducted.
items.decision: No additive stake valuation. A market-value SOTP would first remove the same operating cash, allocations and subsidiary cash/debt; public model has no clean standalone forecast to splice.

items.locator: Note3; source verified via issuer XBRL page4435
items.model: Ireland repurchase and extinguished derivative precede starting cash; minority reserve relates to remaining consolidated NCI. No book NCI subtraction.
items.decision: No Ireland liability to remove or asset to add. Arizona legal waterfall is not disclosed sufficiently to calibrate a replacement reserve.

items.item: Operating rent versus finance supplier capacity
items.locator: Annual Note19; Q3 cash flow; cash_conversion_policy.ordinary_budget.DA and later unlevering_and_leases policy
items.model: Operating rent remains in EBIT. Finance-lease depreciation is included in total normalized D&A and added back; supplier-capacity cash is separately deducted and excluded from owned PPE budget. Lease liabilities are not deducted again.
items.decision: No proven rent double count. 1B/year rising3% after2030 is an owned replacement-capacity allowance, not reported fixed debt service. Do not delete it without replacing capacity/investment treatment. The old 2025 maturity table does not explain changed2026 cash prepayments.
items.scope_limit: After2030, physical capex is derived as D&A plus selected net growth investment minus WC; D&A cancels from operating cash. The aggregate normalization does not independently establish which lease assets are excluded from physical replacement capex. No separately disclosed lease-depreciation path permits a quantified correction. This is a stated economic scope, not an audited asset-level lease schedule.

items.model: 8B of selected existing claims collected2027-29;1B selectedQ4collection;no separate receivable addition. Residual .9B is not explicitly mapped.
items.decision: Residual is a mapping issue, not a proven .9B cash omission: disclosed pool is primarily AMIC, while Q4CFO and ordinary tax budgets are not decomposed to rule out overlap. At face it is at most .16334/share before timing. No positive correction credited.

items.item: New capital credits and tax basis
items.locator: Form3468 PartIV; section50(c); current owned tax policy
items.model: 35% of selected53B qualified basis; cash credit follows one year;21% of credit charged as lost depreciation tax shield in origin year;ordinarytax15%→18% kept separate.
items.decision: Already included. Cash-tax timing can be conservative but requires jurisdiction, loss utilization and placed-in-service data. Do not add deferred-tax assets or remove all basis loss while preserving new credits.

items.model: 5.51B planning shares include remaining escrow;future2.64B escrow cash separately in treasury;no duplicate derivative debt. Conditional warrants excluded while Intel retains51% foundry control.
items.decision: No claim reserve available to reverse. Foundry-sale alternatives require paired warrant settlement and proceeds; not free value.

items.model: Carrying debt/par runoff convention;1B annual cash income already enters treasury. Derivative and collateral conventions are disclosed limits.
items.decision: 6.734B gross mark difference is not a matched Dec2026 bridge. No additive interest-income asset or double-counted cash. Instrument-level debt/hedge revaluation would be a separate valuation-method change.

items.model: Original stress has no response. New conditional draw/repay overlay retains the operating shortfall and charges financing cost.
items.decision: Valid conditional response with verified size/maturity, unverified future access/rate/fees. No equity-value creation from proceeds.

items.locator: Q3 Notes5/14; annual EC-funded guarantee disclosures
items.model: Restricted cash excluded; prior EC collateral funding means no second unpaired reserve.
items.decision: No unsupported restricted-cash release or automatic EC reserve reversal.

conclusion: No justified positive asset/claim correction established. Concrete improvement is a conditional committed-facility response to liquidity stress, with small financing cost and no invented operating upside.
